# Dependency audit — defensive review for hijacks, typosquats and supply-chain attacks

Curated by Skill Harbor — @briiirussell's dependency-audit skill: a defensive review checklist for vetting any new dependency before it enters your project. Walks through registry reputation (npm, PyPI, crates.io), release-history anomalies (version squatting, rapid publishes), suspicious package behaviors to flag (postinstall scripts, obfuscated code, credential access, network calls), when to prefer safer alternatives, and audit scripts to run. Honest caveats: this is a review methodology, not an automated scanner — it won't catch what you don't look at; pair it with real tooling (npm audit, pip-audit, socket.dev) for enforcement. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
